package.description: Managing drivers, vehicles, and orders all on one user interface.

en-US.description: Managing drivers, vehicles, and orders all on one user interface.
en-US.longDescription: To manage a fleet with economic efficiency and to keep all relevant details in view is a very challenging task. Stay on the safe side. Use the Fleetboard Cockpit, which combines all services booked by you in an easy-to-overview and intuitive user interface. This enables you to keep every detail in view and to conveniently access driver, vehicle, trailer and order data any time. For significantly less complexity and full transparency.
en-US.name: Fleetboard Cockpit

zh-CN.description: 在一个操作界面即可完成驾驶员、车辆及订单的统筹管理。
zh-CN.longDescription: 高效管理车队并掌控所有相关细节是一项极具挑战性的任务。确保万无一失——使用 Fleetboard Cockpit，它将您订购的所有服务整合在一个直观清晰的操作界面中。通过该系统，您既能全面把控每个细节，又能随时便捷调取驾驶员、车辆、挂车及订单数据。大幅降低管理复杂度，实现全流程透明化。
